name: observe_native_ui
description: Observe an already-running native app by PID and window ID, bound to the active Mach-O target. Captures a bounded accessibility tree and selected-window screenshot; OS permission denial fails without broad capture or target launch. native_ui_deadline_ms is the observation deadline (omitted means 180000 ms, range 1..2147483647, next call). It does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance or the 180000 ms wait-step cap.
